hero.headline: Mantu Pani
hero.subheadline: architects backend systems and the AI that runs on top of them.
hero.description: Staff Engineer with 8+ years building production backend systems and, more recently, GenAI-powered workflow automation. From Node.js microservices on AWS to LangChain/LangGraph agents that turn plain-English prompts into working workflows — I like taking a system from "someone has to do this by hand" to "the platform just does it."

paragraphs: I'm a Staff Engineer with over eight years of experience across the full backend stack — Node.js, NestJS, Express, AdonisJS — and cloud infrastructure on both AWS and Azure. Most of my career has been spent designing microservices architectures, writing the CI/CD pipelines that ship them, and debugging the production issues that come after.

Over the last year and a half that's expanded into GenAI: building agentic workflow automation with LangChain and LangGraph, standing up MCP servers, and designing systems where a plain-English prompt can generate a working workflow instead of someone building it by hand in a UI. I currently work as a Staff Engineer at Altimetrik India on projects for client BHN (Blackhawk Networks), after four years at Happiest Minds and two years at LitmusWorld before that.

I hold an MCA from Roland Institute of Technology and a BCA from Disha College of Management and Technology, both in Odisha. Along the way I've picked up a PDES Superstar Award (FY2025), several quarterly excellence awards, and a habit of doing a quick proof-of-concept before committing to a feature.

facts.label: companies, from startups to enterprise clients

projects.title: Notification Manager GenAI
projects.description: R&D-driven system that generates campaign workflows from a plain-English prompt instead of manual UI configuration, using LangChain.js and Ollama — with human review still in the loop while the prompting gets refined.

projects.title: Notification Manager
projects.description: Notification orchestration platform supporting scheduled, interval-based, and immediate campaigns. Designed the high-level architecture and built the backend on AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge.

projects.title: Preference Manager
projects.description: Full-stack service letting users configure preferences per campaign type, with JSON Schema driving both input validation and UI configuration. Built and maintained both backend and frontend.

projects.title: Career Edge — Job Posting Platform
projects.description: Job board built from scratch on a microservices architecture: posting, search, apply flows, and employer dashboards, across separate Core and Employer services on AWS.

projects.title: Mintbook eLibrary Platform
projects.description: Subscription-based e-library letting organizations buy access to ebooks and videos for their members. Built the eReader integration in JavaScript and wrote the backend APIs in PHP for smooth, fast content delivery.

projects.title: TSCL Smart City Kiosk
projects.description: Kiosk portal for Tumakuru Smart City Lounge connecting multiple payment sources for utility bill payment and mobile recharge, with a Node.js backend and front-end integration for the on-site touchscreen experience.

projects.title: File Upload Service
projects.description: Node.js microservice handling the full upload pipeline: antivirus scanning with ClamAV, encryption, and moving files from a temporary Azure location to their final destination, with MongoDB change streams driving real-time status updates.

projects.title: Wobo Server — Legacy Integration
projects.description: Integrated the new file-upload microservice into an existing legacy PHP/React application, bridging newer Node.js/NestJS services with the older codebase without disrupting existing functionality.

experience.description: Architect enterprise-grade microservices on Node.js, NestJS, AWS Lambda and EventBridge. Design AI-powered workflow automation using LLMs and LangChain, including a LangGraph-based recommendation engine. Build reusable AI skills and agent-compatible tools, and run CI/CD via Jenkins, GitHub Actions and CloudFormation.

Led backend engineering and microservices development on NestJS, MongoDB and AWS. Built a secure file-upload microservice with ClamAV virus scanning and encryption, migrated legacy systems into scalable microservices, and mentored developers through architecture and code reviews.

Built a customer-experience analytics platform on Angular and Elasticsearch, including dynamic survey systems with real-time dashboards. Debugged production issues via AWS CloudWatch and wrote custom JS for client-specific question rendering.

Built an LMS platform from scratch — course upload, assignment, and progress tracking — deployed for clients including Canara Bank and the Karnataka Public Library Department. Also developed backend services for an IoT-based digital education device.

contact.leadText: Open to Staff / Senior Engineer roles across backend and AI systems, and to interesting consulting problems. The fastest way to reach me is email or phone.
